answer: Fingerprint escrow stops a tide of cloned identities. Each applicant locks 120 coins, twice monthly earnings, and registers a timing and task fingerprint. Each epoch it must match its own history; a copy matching an existing vertex is frozen. A score falling to its nadir after mismatches forfeits the escrow. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 coins, yet frozen clones earn nothing. An honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
